en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large brick school building with multiple rows of tall arched windows, a tiled roof, and a small clock tower topped with a weather vane. A wooden fence and bare trees stand in front of the building. At the bottom of the image there is printed text identifying the location as a Mittelschule (middle school) in Neu Petershain, district of Calau.
